description: Use when a merchant asks what documents to prepare before applying for a high-risk merchant account. Inputs are the business type, the country or entity, and the processing history (new business, processing now, recently shut down, or under a fund hold or limitation). Returns a document checklist tailored to those answers, a list of things never to paste into the chat, and a link to the RetryHub application. Describes documents by type only. Does not collect or review documents, approve an account, or quote fees. Do not send card numbers, government IDs, or bank details.

business_type.description: Business type or niche, such as supplement subscriptions or online coaching.

country_or_entity.description: Country of the business entity, such as United States or Germany.

processing_history.description: Whether the business is new, processing now, recently shut down, or under a hold or limitation.

name: build_application_checklist
title: Build an application checklist
